entry.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
entry.audience: Anyone demonstrating AI literacy on AWS

reading.cost: 100 USD. Visit Exam pricing for additional cost information, including foreign exchange rates.
reading.format: It is a 65-question exam delivered at a Pearson VUE testing center or through online proctoring.
reading.status: The Italian and German versions of the exam will be retired after October 15, 2026.
reading.summary: This certification validates foundational knowledge of AI, machine learning, and generative AI concepts and use cases for AWS services. It is intended as a starting point for people exploring AI/ML on AWS. Holding it demonstrates broad foundational knowledge of AI, ML, generative AI, and AWS AI services.
reading.audience: It is for individuals who want to validate foundational AI/ML and generative AI knowledge on AWS, including those in cloud, development, data, IT, AI/ML, or line-of-business roles. The ideal candidate is familiar with AI/ML technologies on AWS and uses, but does not necessarily build, AI/ML solutions.
reading.prerequisites: No formal prerequisites are stated. The page recommends that people new to IT and AWS Cloud start with AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials. Those holding AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or an Associate-level AWS Certification can skip foundational cloud courses.

same_level.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
same_level.note: Foundational Microsoft credential. The required exam is now AI-901, and Microsoft states the English version was updated on April 15, 2026 and expects knowledge of Python syntax

same_provider.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
same_provider.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate

same_provider.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
same_provider.note: The AWS machine learning credential still on offer after the Machine Learning Specialty was retired in March 2026
